summary: Describes an EDNS(0) option for DNS Update requesters and authoritative servers to include a lease duration in an update or its response. The server can then clean up stale records that were added by updates but never renewed.

eli5.summary: If you leave a note on a shared board, it should disappear after a while unless you renew it. This lets DNS records have an expiry date so old ones get tidied away.

questions: how to expire stale dns records added by dns update
